physical_description.hair_style: Wrapped in a cream-colored headwrap most days, occasionally worn loose in a close-cropped fade
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with light hazel rings — the effect of age and intensity

Skin shows the texture of someone who works outdoors and doesn't hide from the sun. High cheekbones with a subtle width reflecting East Asian ancestry; defined jawline with warmth from African and Middle Eastern heritage.
distinguishing_marks: A long, thin scar running from her left temple down toward her jaw — surgical precision, not street violence, possibly from early augmentation removal or medical intervention
Faded indigo tattoo on her right forearm: a geometric pattern resembling a Ndebele design, roughly 8cm tall, done with hand-pricking ink — community marker, not corporate
Small burn scar on her left palm, pale and smooth — old thermal injury
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. Her augmentations, if any, are subcutaneous or internal — she operates on trust and reputation, not chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy. Plants her feet when she stops — grounded stance. Doesn't fidget. Her gaze is steady and evaluative; she watches more than she speaks. Hands stay visible and open, a habit of someone who defuses rather than escalates. Walks with the weight of authority earned, not inherited.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical. Favors neutral earth tones: cream, tan, dark brown. Wears a weathered linen jacket over functional underlayers — multiple pockets, reinforced seams. Good boots, well-maintained but clearly worn. A simple silver bangle on her right wrist and a thin leather cord around her neck (religious or protective, intentionally understated). No visible logos or corpo affiliations. Everything chosen for durability and community respect, not status signaling.
